description: This file defines the Filter class used for constructing SQL WHERE clauses based on filter parameters, including handling operators, custom fields, and deletion status within the SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: A class for parsing filter parameters into SQL WHERE clauses, supporting various operators and handling custom fields and deletion flags.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Filter with a database manager instance.

methods.name: parseWhere
methods.description: Generates a SQL WHERE clause string based on provided filter parameters and a SugarBean object.

methods.name: addDeletedParameter
methods.description: Deprecated method to add a default 'deleted' parameter to filter parameters.

methods.name: checkOperator
methods.description: Validates that a given operator string is a recognized filter operator.
